Jos Buttler Nears T20I Run Record, Needs 194 to Surpass Kohli and Sharma

England captain Jos Buttler is approaching a significant milestone in T20 International cricket. He is currently 31 runs away from breaking the record for the most runs in T20Is, a record currently held by Indian cricketers Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma. To achieve this, Buttler would need to score 194 runs.
